items.reason: Verifier results produce timestamped reports under the set’s verify directory.
Reports accumulate per verification; agent fallback produces one final report.
The verdict line remains first in the response contract and is removed from the report body.
Parsing behavior is unchanged; malformed replies retain their raw text.
Report writing covers PASS, FIXABLE, and NEEDS-HUMAN.
PASS findings must explain the checks and why each criterion is met.
Cache reads bypass report writing.
Invalidation deletes verdict rows without deleting reports.
Previous reports stay outside Verifier prompts; human notes still pass through.
Accept writes a human report without invoking an agent.
The human report includes the rationale and overridden verdict.
The Authored by field identifies human reports.
Human reports use the shared directory, filename, header, and latest-report reader.
The gate preamble shows the latest report path and commit without its body.
The paging entry opens the report and returns to the gate.
The set detail view includes the Verify report pointer.
Verify reports rank above Refine reports in Artifacts.
Agent prompts gain no report pointer; golden changes cover only the Verifier response contract.
Missing reports produce no report preamble, paging entry, detail section, or artifact.
Verification status and badge logic remain unchanged.
Status rows retain reason truncation but gain no adjacent report pointer; the pointer appears only in the detail view.
Both passes use shared rendering, storage, timestamp scanning, and document header reading.
Refine retains its directory, filename format, header, and existing display text.
Refine prompt golden files are unchanged.

scores.rationale: Clear shared implementation with broad tests, but the status-row pointer is missing; tests were not executed under the read-only grading constraint.

A human's accepted verdict leaves a report of what it overrode
The Verify report reaches the human wherever a set is read
